meta.cap_rule: Cap band = the AMFI large/mid/small tag the vendor stamps on each disclosed holding, taken as the majority of the schemes holding the stock in its LATEST tagged month (holders disagree on 0.05% of stock-months). It is as of that data month, not today; a stock nobody holds any more carries its last disclosed band and the row says so. No tag in any month = Unclassified, never Small. 35% of stocks changed band since 2016, so a band filter judges an old trade by the stock's current band.
meta.index_rule: Index = the market-cap band the stock sits in on TODAY's NSE lists: Nifty 50, Next 50, Midcap (NIFTY Midcap 150), Smallcap (NIFTY Smallcap 250), Microcap (NIFTY Microcap 250), or Outside all of them. The bands do not overlap and cover all 747 listed constituents. The full membership list (Nifty 100 / 200 / 500 too) is on each row as `ixs`.
meta.basis: traded = change in bonus/split-adjusted shares x that month's implied price (industry market value / industry shares). Entries are full purchases, exits full sales, a merger is neither (null). Shares are on today's basis.
meta.source: SEBI monthly portfolio disclosures via MFI360; corporate actions from NSE; stock identity from the NSE bhavcopy lineage
